worlds.title: Green Coast: continental lowlands and branching river plains
worlds.objective: A warm island-continent surrounded by ocean, with eroded inland uplands, branching river plains, seasonal forests, inland lakes and an irregular mix of sandy bays, low shores and rocky headlands.

worlds.title: Rift Highlands: alpine catchments and authored river journeys
worlds.objective: A cold tectonic island-continent surrounded by ocean, with highland interiors, glacial valleys, lower coastal plains, cliff headlands, sheltered beaches, inland lakes and manually directed river journeys.
